body:
Can confirm this issue in Godot 4.4.1 on Linux.
From my testing, this seems to be a problem with AnimationNodes (not just StateMachines) trying to load themselves inside themselves.

I was able to reproduce the exact same issue with an AnimationNodeBlendTree (AnimationBlendSpace1D and AnimationBlendSpace2D just crash Godot).

I was also able to trigger this issue inside a game by manually adding the AnimationNodeBlendTree inside itself during runtime. [Here's the project where I did this.](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/21496204/tree_bomb.zip) **Same advice as Bitlytic, be careful if you run the program and have a Task Manager on hand to close it.**

**Edit:** Just realized that adding `@tool` at the top of the script inside my project creates a project that triggers the issue as soon as the project is opened within Godot. Yikes...

**Edit 2:** While I'm at it, this issue exists in Godot 3.6.1 and the recently released Godot 4.5 beta 4.
